cards.text: Jesus enters Jericho and is passing through. There's a man there named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, and he is VERY wealthy. He's trying to see who Jesus is, and friend, he's got the money, he's got the title, and he STILL can't get a look.
Zacchaeus can't see over the crowd, because he is small in stature. But this man wants to see Jesus, friend, and he is NOT giving up.

cards.question: Zacchaeus is too small to see over the crowd in Jericho. What does he do?

answers.text: Runs ahead and climbs a tree
Pushes his way to the front
Asks the crowd to let him through

cards.text: He runs on ahead and climbs a sycamore tree, since Jesus is about to pass that way. The money, the title, ALL of it, and the man is sitting on a BRANCH.
Jesus comes to that spot, looks up, calls Zacchaeus by name and tells him to hurry down. Friend, you climb a tree just to get a LOOK, and Jesus looks STRAIGHT UP at YOU and says your NAME.

cards.question: Jesus tells Zacchaeus to hurry down out of the sycamore tree. What reason does Jesus give?

answers.text: He must stay at his house today
The crowd is about to block the road
He has a message for all of Jericho

cards.question: Zacchaeus hurries down from the tree and welcomes Jesus ___.

cards.text: Jesus is headed to stay at the house of Zacchaeus, the chief tax collector, and people see it. Friend, when everybody sees where you're going, everybody's got an OPINION.

cards.question: When the people see Jesus go with Zacchaeus, what do they say?

answers.text: He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man
He has gone to be the guest of a Pharisee
He has passed by the rest of Jericho

cards.text: But Zacchaeus stands up and speaks to the Lord about his possessions and the poor. Friend, out of everybody in Jericho, I did NOT expect the chief tax collector to bring up the POOR.

cards.question: Zacchaeus tells the Lord he gives ___ of his possessions to the poor.

cards.text: And Zacchaeus isn't done. He brings up what he'll do if he has cheated anyone, and friend, that's a tax collector going through his OWN receipts out loud.

cards.question: If Zacchaeus has cheated anyone, what does he tell the Lord he'll do?
Jesus tells Zacchaeus that today ___ has come to this house.
Jesus says salvation has come to Zacchaeus's house today. What reason does He give?

answers.text: This man too is a son of Abraham
This man has kept the whole law
This man was first to see Me

cards.text: Then Jesus says what the Son of Man came to do, and Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10). Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, so lean in, because this line hits me right in the apron.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man came to seek and to save the ___.
